        <;> simp [Nat.succ_eq_add_one]

        simp [pow_zero]
        <;> ring_nf
        <;> rfl

        (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n + 1 - j) * Nat.choose (n + 1 + j) j) = 
        2 * (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + 1 + j) j) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        have h_le : j ≤ n := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hj |>.2
        have h_sub : n + 1 - j = 1 + (n - j) := by
          omega

        ∀ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, Nat.choose (n + 1 + j) j = Nat.choose (n + j) j + Nat.choose (n + j) (j - 1) := by
        intro j hj

            <;> simp [Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm]
            <;> omega

        (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + 1 + j) j) = 
        (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n - j) * (Nat.choose (n + j) j + Nat.choose (n + j) (j - 1))) := by

        <;> omega

theorem putnam_2020_a2
  (k : ℕ) :
  (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 k, 2 ^ (k - j) * Nat.choose (k + j) j) = 4 ^ k := by
  -- Helper definitions

  set T := fun n => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j + 1) j

    intro n
    induction' n with n ih
    · -- Base case n = 0
      simp [S]
      <;> norm_num
    · -- Inductive step
      have h_S_rec : S (n + 1) = 4 * S n := by

          <;> simp [Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
          <;> ring_nf
        rw [h_sum_split]
        
        -- Simplify last term
        have h_last_term : 2 ^ (n + 1 - (n + 1)) * Nat.choose (n + 1 + (n + 1)) (n + 1) = Nat.choose (2 * n + 2) (n + 1) := by

          <;> rfl

        have h_sum_factor : 
          (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), 2 ^ (n + 1 - j) * Nat.choose (n + 1 + j) j) = 
          2 * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + 1 + j) j) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
